image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of two street signs mounted on a dark metal pole against a building facade. The left sign is a colorful, artistic square panel with abstract shapes and text in Hebrew and English ('CIRCUS'). The right sign is a standard rectangular white street name sign with black Hebrew and English text ('LICHINBO...'). The background shows architectural details of a building with windows.

The architectural lines in the background show slight inconsistency in vanishing points, particularly around the window frames, suggesting minor geometric warping.
